description.text: Inside a bare concrete space, near-total darkness fills the frame;

sits motionless at the edge of visibility, its long low body almost merging with the shadow. A thin rim of dim light traces the line of the carbon-fibre body, and the faintest reflection runs along the hood, enough to reveal the car without lighting the rest of the space. The floor is smooth, cold grey concrete with a few soft patches of pooled shadow; the walls are out of view except for a vague sense of enclosure. Nothing else in the room is lit, so the car remains the only readable object, held in a quiet, heavy stillness. Dust and air are barely suggested by the soft falloff of the light. The car does not move yet; its stance is settled and level, with the front end facing toward the open darkness. The mood is restrained and mechanical, built from the contrast between the black bodywork and the weak silver edge light.
Near-total darkness in a bare concrete space;
is barely readable at the edge of the light.
A low idle engine rumble with a faint echo in the empty concrete space.
The camera holds a static shot.

pulls forward out of the shadow. The front of the car advances steadily, its carbon-fibre panels catching the first real light; the hood and nose brighten in a narrow band while the flanks remain deep black. The bodywork sheens and settles, and small highlights slide along the edges as the car comes clear of the darkness. The concrete floor under the tyres becomes visible in soft grey planes, and the car's reflection stretches and breaks across the surface. The movement is smooth and deliberate, not hurried: the car maintains a low, even pace as it emerges, keeping its nose aimed toward the open foreground. The background stays dark and uncluttered, so the changing light on the body is the main visual event. A low engine note rises with the motion, and the sound of tyres rolling across concrete joins the idle rumble, filling the empty space with a steady mechanical presence.
pulls forward out of the shadow toward the open foreground.
The engine note rises as the car begins to move.
Carbon-fibre panels catch the first real light as the car comes clear of the darkness.
Tyres roll across the concrete floor.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
